decisions.briefing: Markets were neutral today (NASDAQ -0.5%, S&P 500 -0.3%) with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($189.29) is well below the $500 deployment threshold, so per strategy memory we hold rather than forcing a buy, and let existing positions ride on their stop-loss/profit-target rules.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today, with the NASDAQ down 0.5% and the S&P 500 down 0.3%, reflecting a broadly neutral, low-conviction trading session rather than any sharp risk-off move.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市溫和回落，納斯達克指數下跌0.5%，標普500指數下跌0.3%，整體屬於方向不明的中性交易日，並非明顯的避險拋售。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder means keeping cash uninvested and ready until a genuinely attractive opportunity appears, instead of deploying it just because it's sitting idle. With only $189 in cash today and a neutral market, waiting is the disciplined move rather than chasing a marginal setup.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指保留現金待機，直到出現真正有吸引力的機會才出手，而不是因為現金閒置就勉強買入。今日現金只有189美元，加上大市方向不明，按兵不動才是紀律的做法，而非勉強追逐次等機會。
